****According to data from [[Kpler]], three [[oil tanker#The supertanker era|oil supertankers]] from [[Saudi Arabia]] carrying 6 million barrels of [[Petroleum|crude oil]] were seen transiting through the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. **[[2026 Lebanon war]]
***[[Israel]]i [[airstrikes]] kill at least three people across [[southern Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/18/israeli-attacks-on-southern-lebanon-kill-three-despite-us-iran-deal (Al Jazeera)]
***Israel publishes a map of southern Lebanon that it will [[Israeli occupation of Southern Lebanon (2026)|continue to illegaly occupy]], and says it may launch attacks beyond it, as [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli prime minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] rules out a withdrawal of [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli troops]] from [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-talks-with-us-over-continuing-its-lebanon-troop-deployment-officials-say-2026-06-18/ (Reuters)] [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3357629/netanyahu-rules-out-israeli-troop-withdrawal-southern-lebanon (''South China Morning Post'')]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Ukraine]] launches its largest ever [[Drone warfare|drone attack]] on [[Moscow]], [[Russia]], targeting the [[Moscow Refinery]] and damaging several residential buildings. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-moscow-refinery-attack-oil-0ee97c720e770c392067418f9cabcbba (AP)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2026/06/18/europe/ukraine-strikes-moscow-oil-refinery-intl-hnk (CNN)]
***Residents of Moscow report oil [[rain]]ing down as massive plumes of black smoke are visible over the city. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c98291g5rr1o (BBC News)]
***Following the attack, [[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian president]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] threatened Moscow saying, "If Ukraine burns, your Moscow will burn", warning against further Russian attacks on the country. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/jun/18/ukraine-russia-moscow-strikes-nato-defence-ministers-hegseth-rutte-latest-news-updates (''The Guardian'')]
***Russia says it will carry out a "massive retaliation" against Ukraine with [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Russian foreign minister]] [[Sergey Lavrov]] saying the [[Russian Armed Forces]] will from now on, carry out "massive group strikes" on a "regular basis" following the attack on Moscow. [https://www.msn.com/en-gb/news/insight/russia-vows-massive-retaliation-after-record-ukraine-drone-blitz/gm-GM40DE8583?gemSnapshotKey=GM40DE8583-snapshot-11&uxmode=ruby (MSN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A fire at a [[Wyndham Hotels & Resorts|Wyndham resort]] in [[Bayahíbe]], [[Dominican Republic]], kills one person, injures several others, and prompts the evacuation of nearly 1,700 [[Tourism in the Dominican Republic|tourists]]. Authorities state that [[combustible]] roofing materials and wind conditions contribute to the fire's spread. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/one-killed-hundreds-evacuated-due-fire-hotel-dominican-republic-2026-06-19/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 Ebola epidemic]]
**The [[Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention]] reports that the [[Ebola]] outbreak in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] has caused 202 deaths from 875 confirmed cases. Health officials cite difficulties in [[contact tracing]], while the [[Red Cross]] warns that the outbreak has not yet peaked. [https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/06/18/ebola-death-toll-passes-200-dr-congo/ (AFP via ''Jamaica Observer'')]
*[[MV Hondius hantavirus outbreak|MV ''Hondius'' hantavirus outbreak]]
**Two more passengers who were on the [[MV Hondius|MV ''Hondius'']] [[cruise ship]] during the [[hantavirus]] outbreak exit the [[National Quarantine Unit]] at the [[University of Nebraska Medical Center]] in [[Omaha, Nebraska|Omaha]], [[Nebraska]], making the total amount of people remaining in quarantine to six. [https://omaha.com/news/local/article_86142f53-a57c-4ebd-b400-1bd774511601.html (''Omaha World-Herald'')] [https://www.centralnebraskatoday.com/2026/06/18/two-more-former-mv-hondius-passengers-released-after-five-weeks/ (Central Nebraska Today)]
*A study published in the ''[[The Lancet]]'' [[medical journal]], led by the [[Queen Mary University of London]] and funded by [[Cancer Research UK]], estimates that the [[HPV vaccine|HPV]] [[vaccine]] has prevented around 200 deaths from [[cervical cancer]] in [[England]]. Additionally, the study also finds that no women aged 20–24 have died from the disease between 2020 and 2024. [https://news.sky.com/story/children-vaccinated-for-hpv-have-close-to-zero-risk-of-dying-from-cervical-cancer-before-age-30-study-suggests-13555218 (Sky News)] 
*[[Australia]]n researchers report that an H5 [[avian influenza]] outbreak on [[Heard Island and McDonald Islands]] has killed more than 13,000 [[southern elephant seal]] pups and has infected local [[Birds of Australia|bird]] and penguin populations, marking the virus's first detection in an [[States and territories of Australia|Australian external territory]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/australianz/bird-flu-kills-13000-seal-pups-on-remote-australian-island (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
*Scientists confirm that [[Major Oak]], a 1,000-year-old [[Oak|oak tree]] in [[Sherwood Forest]], [[Nottinghamshire]], [[England]], has died. The tree failed to produce any new leaves this year after becoming "stressed" by a series of hot, dry summers over the last decade. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/jun/18/most-famous-tree-world-sherwood-forest-ancient-major-oak-dies (''The Guardian'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Labour Party leadership crisis]]
**[[2026 Makerfield by-election]]
***Former [[Greater Manchester]] [[Mayor of Greater Manchester|mayor]] [[Andy Burnham]] is elected to the [[House of Commons of the United Kingdom|House of Commons]] of the [[United Kingdom]] after winning a [[by-election]] in [[Makerfield (constituency)|Makerfield]], setting up a leadership challenge to [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|prime minister]] [[Keir Starmer]].  [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/jun/19/andy-burnham-wins-makerfield-byelection-paving-way-labour-leadership-challenge (''The Guardian'')]
*[[President of Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyz president]] [[Sadyr Japarov]] signs an order to dismiss Abdupaty Matkalikov from his post as mayor of [[Manas (city)|Manas]], [[Jalal-Abad Region]], [[Kyrgyzstan]]. [https://24.kg/english/378545_President_dismisses_Mayor_of_Manas_city/ (24.kg)] [https://akipress.com/news:902700:Abdupata_Matkalikov_dismissed_from_his_post_as_mayor_of_Manas_city/ (Akipress)]
*The [[National Assembly of Zimbabwe|National Assembly]] of [[Zimbabwe]] approves a bill extending [[Term limit|presidential terms]] from five to seven years, which will allow [[President of Zimbabwe|president]] [[Emmerson Mnangagwa]], whose second term was scheduled to end in 2028, to remain in power until 2030. The [[Constitution of Zimbabwe|constitutional]] [[Constitutional amendment|amendment]] also scraps [[Direct election|direct]] presidential [[Elections in Zimbabwe|elections]], electing future presidents through parliament. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c20y15m0337o (BBC News)]
*The [[National Nutrition Agency]] of [[Indonesia]] suspends [[Free Nutritious Meals|its free meal programme]] during [[Public holidays in Indonesia|public holidays]], citing efficiency and programme review measures. The policy is expected to reduce spending as [[Red and White Cabinet|the government]] seeks to address budget pressures and [[Economy of Indonesia|economic]] challenges. [https://www.nst.com.my/amp/world/region/2026/06/1467682/indonesia-halt-free-meal-scheme-during-holidays (AFP via ''New Straits Times'')]
